records.GPU_NODE_ALLOC_STAGE: device/context/ordinal/domain/stage/cuda_lane/key/epoch plus exact allocator and bounded pending counters
records.GPU_NODE_ALLOC_MODEL: Existing stage additional, retained-after and successor planner inputs, unchanged
records.GPU_NODE_ALLOC_FIXED_LINK: Authenticated provisional FIXED key to final node key plus requested coefficient-alias bytes

semantics: Stable final node key hashes statement, fixed and ordinal; excludes MAIN root so MAIN rebind preserves attribution. Provisional FIXED has a distinct authority and an explicit authenticated link.
Every successful arena allocation records requested reservation bytes before rounding and exact rounded bytes; creator/context admission fields and allocation decisions are unchanged.

Node stage active-request peak excludes shared immutable and idle cache. Whole cached reservation request/rounded peaks charge oversized reuse; node ownership is reassigned on plane reuse and removed only at a joined idle transition.
Stage peaks reset at begin/next; node peaks reset at a new MAIN witness epoch only when no old node live/pending reservations remain. Other nodes cannot reset a node peak.
Live requested/rounded allocator peaks are exact host allocator reservation-lifetime counts with coverage. Pending frees remain tagged until retirement events report completion.
Including-pending value is a conservative upper bound: overlapping/reused ranges and incomplete but already-finished-unqueried fences can double count. It is not an exact GPU-completion peak.
Large and small field maxima are independently observed; use rounded_reservation_peak_bytes for concurrent total. Never sum independent component maxima or requested and pending maxima.
FIXED ingress/commit/adoption are shared-setup rows. Aliases are reported as requested usage without adding the same physical allocation to every user.

Device carve, mapped, mapped-free, small slab, idle cache and shared-long end counts are separate. cudaMemGetInfo is a boundary snapshot; configured/actual stack limits and initialization delta are not exact stack consumption.
Host joins at begin/next/end and idle-cache retirement bindings deliberately perturb scheduling; all diagnostic request walls are disqualified as latency results.

Observer domain is semantic and independent of physical session ownership: resident composition uses Job.outer_workspace; outer PCS adapter sets diagnostic-only Request.allocation_observer_domain=recursion_node. Native requests default native_packet. Scope, wire format, transcript and admission-domain decisions are unchanged.
Native diagnostic stage IDs19/20 are native_gkr/native_binding and retain node ownership; only FIXED setup stage IDs16 through18 are classified as shared setup.

Native SOURCE spans all contributor submissions under one range. Native GKR/binding/global/truth callbacks explicitly name domain2. Retained compact truth MAIN replay uses stage21 native_main_replay and does not reset the node epoch or weaken stage1 zero-live checks.
qualification_requires: Single-lane composed diagnostic first; no two-lane run until user condition satisfied.
Require all expected19 final recursion ordinals, every required MAIN/INTER/composition/PCS phase, complete terminal proof and fresh receiver.
Reject any coverage-gap or close-failure marker, including known-context unscoped short reservations and non-arena/capture pool paths.
Exclude fused Blake shadow/check modes, whose direct cudaMallocAsync allocations bypass this arena ledger.
Compare model inputs in original large/small planner units; preserve shared/cold setup baseline and pending bounds. Do not infer process physical peak or P1 exit from model residuals.
Store only compact JSON+Markdown checkpoint summaries under1MB; reference raw pod artifacts and hashes.
